<title level="1" right="Rules">[Armor Class](/Rules.aspx?ID=199)</title>

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 274 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Your Armor Class (AC) measures how well you can defend against attacks. When a creature attacks you, your Armor Class is the DC for that attack roll.

<center>**Armor Class = 10 + Dexterity modifier (up to your armor’s Dex Cap) + proficiency bonus + armor’s item bonus to AC + other bonuses + penalties**</center> Use your proficiency bonus for the category (light, medium, or heavy) or the specific type of armor you’re wearing. If you’re not wearing armor, use your proficiency in unarmored defense.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
